From NCEI's Global Summary of the Month. No API key required.

description: Get historical weather and climate data from NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI), the US archive of weather observations: daily weather from over 100,000 stations worldwide, hourly reports from US airports, monthly and yearly summaries, and 30-year climate normals with frost dates. Find stations near a place or in an area, and look up NCEI's datasets. No account or API key required.
